# DEVHUB export 0.3.18 - validation build

This archive is PARTIAL and ANALYSIS_ONLY.
Start with catalog/objects.xml and catalog/references.xml.
Programs: source, KO-first text pools with EN fallback, TRDIR.
Unreadable first active source reads are excluded, not error logs.
Known MIME URL/DDIC XML omissions: SKIPPED, one WARNING per object.
These objects have no exported body; other errors remain FAILED.
Class bodies and class-reference diagnostics are outside scope.
Package children included; fixed uncompressed ZIP budget 512 MiB.
MessageClass/<class>/Messages.xml: KO first, EN for missing numbers.
Message long texts are not exported; no other-language fallback.
Dictionary Object: DBtable, Structures, TableType, Domain, Data element.
Other types, screens and GUI status are not serialized yet.
Function Module/<function>/: six tab XMLs and Source code/.
Function API version is UNVERIFIED; it has no STATE parameter.
Function long docs and screens remain incomplete.
BSP pages/events/parameters are read with explicit active version.
Page tabs: Properties.xml, Layout/, Event Handler/,
Page Attributes.xml and Type Definitions.abap.
Event source filenames use actual SAP handler identities.
BSP/function XML keeps API fields; formatted tag/value bytes checked.
Generated XML has indented lines; original web/MIME bytes stay raw.
MIME under an unselected BSP package is excluded before reading.
See catalog/web-assets.xml references for package exclusions.
BSP Application: pages/ and MIMEs/ with original MIME folders.
Standalone SMIM: MIME/<type>/<subtype>/<filename>; ID suffix on collision.
SMIM file/folder metadata: one MIME/metadata.xml per owning package.
W3MI keeps its object grouping under uppercase MIME/W3MI.
.devhub/baseline is the unedited comparison copy; do not index it for AI.
No generated language suffixes in paths; actual language stays in metadata.
Classes and OTR text export remain incomplete.
External or unresolved include owners are reference-only.
Include links are lexical direct edges; macro candidates marked.
Selected roots plus verified owned FUGR includes are scanned.
Same FUGR ownership requires split API, TADIR and main mapping.
Include/includes.xml records actual include read outcomes.
Dependency scan is partial; this is not an ABAP syntax parser.
No other static or dynamic dependency scan is implemented yet.
Do not treat absent files as object deletion.
Do not overlay this partial export onto an existing Git tree.
Extract into a NEW short Windows folder; inspect before copying.
Keep .devhub/baseline unchanged. No import is supported yet.
CRC32 is a checksum, not a secure proof or a conflict decision.
Object definitions were read without a global repository lock.
Repeated export must be compared after extraction, not ZIP bytes.
Execution timestamps exist only in logs/run.xml.
Git commit/push and SAP activation/CTS are separate operations.
